hook: An ornate brass handle turns and a door swings open to reveal an unexpected intruder confronting Juliana over an ailing Duchess.
cliffhanger: The noblewoman smiles smugly, believing she has successfully broken Juliana's spirit and taught her 'her place.'
standalone_clarity: A viewer can easily understand a tyrannical noblewoman abusing an undercover maid, though the exact identity of the poisoned Duchess requires brief context.
narrative_context: Juliana is caught red-handed by a cruel noblewoman while trying to save the poisoned Dowager Duchess, resulting in a brutal physical assault.
promotional_strength: Features high tension, a clear power dynamic, a dramatic physical confrontation, and a high-stakes secret concealment.

evidence.observation: A door opens dramatically to reveal an intruder.
The noblewoman strikes Juliana with a riding crop.

logline: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the ornate brass handle turning slowly on the dark wooden chamber door as it swings open.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy metallic click of the latch and the ominous low creak of the door hinges.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of the dimly lit, vaulted bedchamber. Lady Juliana and Prudence stand rigid beside the heavy four-poster bed as a haughty blonde noblewoman in an elegant lavender empire-line gown enters, clutching a riding crop.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Sharp, Demanding)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: Who are you?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Humble, Measured)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Accusatory, Strict)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Softly Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scoffing, Cruel)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Emphatic, Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: She is suffering.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: Then let her suffer.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: I cannot do that.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: You are a maid.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Yes, my lady.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

source_segments.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending)
source_segments.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
source_segments.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.
